english.title: Fly aircraft under police certificate but other than in accordance with it
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft flying, or intended by

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[the operator of the aircraft]_

to fly, solely under and in accordance with the terms of a police air operator's certificate and which flew

(E)_[other than under and in accordance with the terms of Part 1 and Part 2 of a police operations manual]_
(F)_[when Part 1 of the police operations manual had not been approved for the aircraft by the CAA]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 135 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the operator or pilot in command of an aircraft flying, or intended by the suspect or the operator of the aircraft
to fly solely under and in accordance with the terms of a police air operator's certificate
and which flew other than under and in accordance with the terms of Part 1 and Part 2 of a police operations manual OR
when Part 1 of which must have been approved for the aircraft by the CAA
